name: dealerai-os
description: AI Operating System for Automotive Marketing, Sales & Growth

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run python -m dealerai.scripts.migrate
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d dealerai
scripts.api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn dealerai.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run api
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && uv run mypy src
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:guards && npm run check:web
scripts.worker: cd apps/api && uv run python -m dealerai.worker
scripts.eval: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -m eval -v
scripts.eval:gateway: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/evals/test_gateway_cache.py -m eval -v
scripts.db:migrate:staging: cd apps/api && uv run python -m dealerai.scripts.migrate --env-file .env.staging
scripts.eval:vision: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/evals/test_vision_live.py -m eval -v
scripts.eval:enrichment: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/evals/test_enrichment_live.py -m eval -v
scripts.creative:goldens: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/media -k golden --update-goldens -q
scripts.test:guards: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/guards --cov=dealerai.guards --cov=dealerai.core.text --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.eval:tools: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/evals/test_tools_live.py -m eval -v
scripts.eval:content: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/evals/test_content_live.py -m eval -v
scripts.eval:csv: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/evals/test_csv_mapping_live.py -m eval -v
